thread:
sam: prepping a config-only rollout in us-east for routing+batching tweaks. target: validate tiny-batch behavior and routing fallback. start in 20m.

sam: planned steps: 10% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100% over ~90m if green. will pin model to v1.12-quant to reduce variability.

deploy-bot: scheduled config-only canary 'slimwave-1755555' starting in 20m. dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/slimwave-1755555 :calendar: 

maya: dropping config blob here. tiny_batch_size=6, max_batch_delay_ms=30, request_timeout_ms=8500, kv_cache_ttl_ms=300000, route_primary=0.85, route_fallback=0.15, max_inflight_per_shard=160, pinned_model=v1.12-quant.

oncall: watchlist: p95, p99, error-rate, 5xx downstream, kv_evictions, token/cost delta. rollback triggers: p95 > 350ms sustained 10m OR error-rate +60% vs baseline OR kv_evictions spike >5/s.

vic: can we AB tiny_batch=6 vs tiny_batch=3 inside the canary? maybe smaller batches reduce tail.

sam: good idea. will run 50/50 split at canary level if initial 10% looks stable.

deploy-bot: canary started at 10% (5% groupA tiny=6, 5% groupB tiny=3). observability links: dashboards/slimwave | traces/slimwave-1755555

maya: after 12m groupB (tiny=3) p95 dropped ~35ms, p99 similar, cost +-1%. logs show lower batch_wait_ms on groupB.

oncall: AB check 18m: groupA p95=240ms, groupB p95=205ms, p99 stable. no errors. recommend promote to 40% with groupB weighted higher (60%).

sam: promote to 40% now and shift weights so groupB gets 60% of canary traffic.

deploy-bot: applied routing weight change: canary=40%, groupB weight increased. change logged: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/slimwave-1755555/changes/2

vic: saw a tiny p99 uptick when a heavy tenant hit a single shard at +45m. oncall rebalanced traffic and spike subsided. not across tenants.

oncall: noted. still within thresholds. continuing ramp to 80% over next 30m. will page if triggers hit.

release-manager: please add to release notes: config-only tweak, AB tested tiny_batch 3 vs 6, pinned model v1.12-quant, observed 12-15% p95 improvement on smaller batch, no cost regression.

sam: rolling final step to 100% now. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: canary slimwave-1755555 completed rollout to 100% at 1755555380. release artifact: https://deploys.redwood/releases/rel-2026-01-slimwave-1755555

maya: no rollback needed. well monitor for 72h. proposing follow-up: add an automated AB recipe for tiny_batch recommendations in Optimize.

oncall: agreed. nice safe config-only flow. :thumbsup:
notes: config-only canary with AB on tiny batch; routing weight promotes; monitored metrics and minor transient p99 handled
